exposure: Left-sided congenital heart defects (aortic coarctation, aortic stenosis, hypoplastic left heart, and complex left heart defects)
outcome: Cord blood concentrations of N-terminal precursor of B-type natriuretic peptide (NT-proBNP)
cohort: 45 fetuses with left heart defects (29 favorable and 16 poor outcomes) and 35 control fetuses evaluated in the third trimester of pregnancy between 2013-2019 in Spain
finding: Cord blood biomarker profiles differed significantly between fetuses with left heart defects and controls, and between those with favorable and poor outcomes, suggesting their potential prognostic value.
